verdict.rationale: There is no documented data-export feature. Conductor's core work product does live in open formats: standard git worktrees and branches that become pull requests. The Conductor API can also read agent replies from cloud workspaces programmatically, and chat images can be downloaded. That is glancing, indirect portability rather than a deliberate export-and-leave path. Missing for 10: a documented full export of chats, workspaces, settings and routines; open or standard export formats for non-code data; account deletion or offboarding docs; independent corroboration.
